falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows would invalidate the 80% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug, as that low held firm; this would signal structural weakness not present in the reference pattern

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom featured VIX peaking near 28 and rapidly mean-reverting; sustained VIX above 35 indicates panic-driven liquidation rather than orderly bottoming, breaking the volatility signature of the matched pattern

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% while S&P 500 simultaneously trades below its 20-day moving average
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would confirm a growth-scare flight-to-quality dynamic, whereas the August 2024 bottom occurred with yields stable/rising alongside equity stabilization; the divergence would prove the current macro driver is recession fear, not the soft-landing rebalancing that formed the matched bottom

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
